contexts.text: Man is then gifted with a new will...
They who do this, cannot but be... gifted with the things which are of blessing...
To be able to love another more than himself is the gift of the Lord; from which gift and its happiness he recedes in proportion as...
All the states of innocence and peace with which man is gifted. These states are given to man from infancy.
No one can be gifted with the faculty of perceiving good and truth, except through Knowledges...
It denotes to be gifted with goods and instructed in truths.
The goods of faith, with which they are gifted.
He can then be gifted with heavenly freedom...
The gifts which Abraham gave them () = lots in the Lord's Spiritual Kingdom.
In the other life they are gifted with intelligence and wisdom...
Under Endow, see this reference.
They who are gifted with these things are called the blessed of Jehovah; for they are then gifted with Heaven... AC 4981:2.
That scientifics were gifted with good from truth. Signified.
That they were given and stored up in the threshold of the exterior Natural. Signified.
He is thus gifted with understanding.
That the ordinations of truths were given gratis. Signified, Explained.
Because truth in the exterior Natural appears to be given gratis. Signified, Explained.

Man does not at all know what is given him gratis... Thus he does not at all believe that anything is given him; when yet all that truth which he concludes rationally from scientifics... is such that it is given him... Whereas the angelic Societies know and perceive this clearly, not only what is given them gratis, but also where it is. Example(s).
That they should no longer procure truths... and goods... but be gifted with them from the Lord. Signified.
No one can be gifted with this peace but he who is led by the Lord...
A hidden gift () = the truth and good which are given by the Lord unknown to man.
The truth which is given by the Lord is first received as if it were not given...
Such gifts are given by the Angels to each other.
The faculty of elevation... is that with which the man is gifted who is being regenerated.
(Thus) man cannot be gifted with spiritual good by the Lord... unless he desists from evils.
Cannot be gifted with spiritual life...
Thus be gifted with eternal happiness.
The man who is being regenerated is gifted with both a new understanding and a new will... and unless he is gifted with both, he is not a new man.
To bring a present, and offer a gift () = the good of love and of faith.
According to the reception of good. Heaven is given.
The gifts or presents, which... consisted chiefly of burnt-offerings, sacrifices, and meat-offerings = the interior things of worship; because these were the things represented.
The reason the gifts were called holy, and to give or offer them was called to sanctify them, was because they represented holy things...

The gifts and presents are said to be offered to Jehovah, although the Lord does not receive any gifts or presents, but gives to everyone gratis; but still He wills that they should come from man as from himself, provided he acknowledges that they are... from the Lord. Explained. From this it is evident, that what are called gifts and presents offered to the Lord by man, are in their essence gifts and presents offered to man by the Lord; and that their being called gifts and presents is according to the appearance. All who are wise at heart recognize this appearance, but not so the simple; and yet the gifts and presents of the latter are grateful, so far as they are offered from ignorance in which there is innocence.
The gifts which were offered in the Jewish Church... were called also expiations from sins, because they were offered for the sake of obtaining their remission. Explained.
The upliftings are called gifts given to Jehovah... But it means that they belong to Jehovah, not from any gift, but from possession.
Thus a gift from them is a gift from the Lord.
Their houses... are given them gratis.
All things the Angels need are given them. HH 393:end.
It appears as man's; for... otherwise man... could not be gifted with any intelligence and wisdom.
The king, holding in his hand two gifts... They were celestial forms of gold.
These things shall be given... in the chapter on Free Will.
Through conjunction be gifted with eternal life and blessedness.
She sees him in his gifts, as in mirrors.
The Angels receive such gifts when they please the Lord.
On the intellectual gift.
Therefore it is said that the gift does not sanctify, but the altar (). By the gift are meant the sacrifices...
The hire or gift, of whoredom.
7. The spiritual affections, which are given by the Lord to man...
